description: Makes a key for one workflow (what production uses: it runs that workflow and reads its jobs) and writes it into an env file on this machine, never into the chat. Use an uncommitted file such as .env.local. Returns the key's id and where it went. Code that calls the workflow: POST https://api.extractinsurance.dev/v1/jobs with Authorization: Bearer <key> and the file as the multipart part document (optional part version pins one; default the latest published) → 202 {id}; GET /v1/jobs/{id} until status is no longer queued or running, or let the workflow's webhook receive it; then result.targets.<target id>.value. Read the key from the environment, never write it into the code.

env_file.description: The file to write it to, e.g. .env.local (created if missing; an existing line for env_var is replaced).

mode.description: live (default): published versions; test: also the draft.

workflow.description: The workflow's id (wf_…) or its slug, from list_workflows.

name: create_workflow_key
